title: rect grid
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkRectilinearGridGeometryFilter with warped plane, cut plane, contour, stream tubes, and outline on rectilinear grid.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkCastToConcrete](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCastToConcrete.html) — casts abstract data objects to their concrete types.
- [vtkContourFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContourFilter.html) — extracts iso-surfaces at specified scalar values.
- [vtkCutter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkCutter.html) — cutter.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkDataSetReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetReader.html) — data set reader.
- [vtkNamedColors](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkNamedColors.html) — named colors.
- [vtkOutlineFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkOutlineFilter.html) — generates a bounding box outline of the input data.
- [vtkPlane](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPlane.html) — defines an implicit plane function.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkPolyDataNormals](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataNormals.html) — computes surface normals for smooth shading.
- [vtkRectilinearGridGeometryFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRectilinearGridGeometryFilter.html) — rectilinear grid geometry filter.
- [vtkStreamTracer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkStreamTracer.html) — generates streamlines from a vector field.
- [vtkTubeFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTubeFilter.html) — generates tubes around lines with optional radius variation.
- [vtkWarpVector](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkWarpVector.html) — warp vector.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
